recentItems.title: Flea - Lovelovelove - Helen Burns [HD]
recentItems.description:
"Helen Burns" is the début album from Flea of the Red Hot Chili Peppers. 
"It is a mostly instrumental, weird and arty record, the music is mostly just me creating soundscapes that are very emotional for me, but certainly not for everyone! Just me tripping out at home. I am putting it out to raise money for The Silverlake Conservatory of Music a community based non profit music school that i am an integral part of. There you have it. See you all soon I hope!"
